donate another 10 million volunteer hours over the
next decade and to increase the impact of our skills-

Foundation invest in matching programs and innovative
partnerships and collaborations. In turn, our investments
and support of local communities help us build trust with
external stakeholders and realize our corporate purpose
of enriching lives through technology.
